rows.screenRequirement: 결제 선택 제목 + 보조 설명 (Region 1): 단일 구독 결제 선택 단계 안내. 제목 24자, 보조 설명 80자/2줄, 가격 정보와 분리.

rows.rationale: Static app copy (i18n key paywall.heading/subheading). No DB read needed and none documented. Render-only; satisfied without schema.

rows.screenRequirement: 기존 구독자 분기: 기존 구독자는 결제 선택 대신 구독 관리(X-04)로 유도한다.
rows.docSource: description.md L31 (▣ 예외: 기존 구독자는 결제 선택 대신 구독 관리로 유도)
rows.rationale: description.md (PRIORITY 1) defines a concrete branch that must read the caller's subscription and decide active/trialing → redirect. PaywallShell.useEffect reads fetchMySubscription() and branches on status==='active'||'trialing'. This is a stable-query need on a real validated column (status is CHECK-constrained, owner-RLS filtered). Satisfied by live subscriptions.status; no jsonb blob involved.

rows.screenRequirement: 결제 주기 카드 3열 (Region 2): 월간/분기/연간 플랜을 카드로 비교. active 플랜만 표시.
rows.docSource: description.md L11, L35-39 (Wireframe No.2 결제 주기 카드 3열); screen-data-summary.md L35 (플랜/가격 카드 = 현재 스키마로 충족), L43; 메모 'active plan만 사용자에게 표시한다'
rows.rationale: Card set is built by querying subscription_plans WHERE active=true (fetchActivePlans .eq('active',true)). active is a real validated boolean column → stable-query need met by live schema. Cheapest-first order via price_cents.

rows.docSource: description.md L35-39 (카드 비교 배치) — disambiguated by hifi.png plan card heading; screen-data-summary.md L43 (name)
rows.rationale: Display label per card; live column subscription_plans.name. Render-only.

rows.docSource: description.md L29 (가격 정보와 분리 = 가격은 카드에 존재), L43 (가격 조회 실패 시 기본 가격 문구로 대체); screen-data-summary.md L35, L43 (price_cents, currency)
rows.rationale: Price rendered via formatPlanPrice(price_cents/100, currency). Both are real validated columns. Stable-query/render need satisfied by live schema. Fetch-failure fallback handled in app (description.md exception).

rows.rationale: cadence is a CHECK-constrained enum ('monthly','quarterly','yearly'); app maps to localized label via cadenceLabelKey. Real validated column; satisfied.

rows.docSource: description.md L41 (추천 배지 1개만 표시); screen-data-summary.md L24 (추천 플랜 표시), L35, L43 (recommended)

rows.docSource: description.md L11, L47-53 (Wireframe No.3 결제 주기 선택 CTA); functional-spec.md L24 (업그레이드 CTA)
rows.rationale: CTA carries the selected plan_key as the selection identifier (handleSelect(plan) keys on plan_key, the table PK). The button's loading/dedupe state is client UI. plan_key is a real validated PK; the selection reference is satisfied.

rows.screenRequirement: 결제 checkout 실행 (CTA 클릭 → 외부 결제 provider 흐름, 결과 DB 반영)
rows.docSource: description.md L51 (구독 절차 시작), L55 (결제 실패/미지원 수단/중복 구독 안내); screen-data-summary.md L37 (결제 checkout = DB 계약 없음, 외부 provider 흐름; 결과는 subscriptions/payment_history에 반영), L48
rows.liveDbObject: (missing) — checkout session has no public DB contract; results land in subscriptions / payment_history
rows.rationale: screen-data-summary 확정 계약 explicitly states the checkout session has NO DB contract — it is an external payment provider flow whose results are written to subscriptions/payment_history by the billing service (service_role), not by the client. No client write path, no public RPC, no payment provider wired in code (PaywallShell handleSelect is an external stub showing '연동 예정'). This is genuinely net-new integration scope → UNRESOLVED / escalate; do not invent a checkout column or RPC. Frozen-island unaffected.

rows.screenRequirement: 혜택/지원 패널 (Region 4): 핵심 혜택 정리 + 지원 문의 CTA 1개.
rows.docSource: description.md L11, L59-65 (Wireframe No.4 혜택/지원 패널), L67 (혜택 정보 조회 실패 시 기본 구독 설명만 표시)
rows.rationale: Static benefit/support copy + a mailto support CTA (SUPPORT_EMAIL). No operational/DB source documented; rendered from app i18n strings. Satisfied without schema. (Per-plan benefits live in subscription_plans.features, covered by its own row.)

rows.screenRequirement: 결제 보조 정보 (Region 5): 환불/세금계산서/보안 결제/기관 문의 안내. 4항목 이하, 정책 링크 외부 이동.
rows.docSource: description.md L11, L71-79 (Wireframe No.5 결제 보조 정보), L79 (정책 변경/미확인 정보는 고객지원 문의로 연결)
rows.rationale: Static guidance copy + external policy links. No DB/operational source documented or implied. Render-only; satisfied without schema.

rows.screenRequirement: 접근 제한 안내 / 현재 플랜 표시 (유료 기능 잠금 진입 컨텍스트)
rows.docSource: functional-spec.md L23 (현재 플랜), L25 (제한 안내), L39 (profiles.plan_label, profiles.status read — 현재 플랜과 접근 제한 안내); screen-data-summary.md L45, L56 (profiles 접근 제한 보조; app_role/plan_label/status 보호 컬럼)
rows.rationale: functional-spec lists profiles.plan_label/status as the read backing 현재 플랜/접근 제한 안내 (the legacy paywall evidence). Both are real validated columns (status CHECK-constrained; plan_label default 'free'). description.md (PRIORITY 1) does not narrate plan_label rendering — the priced surface drives off subscriptions.status — so this is a strong-inference supporting read, not a confirmed render in the current shell. Stable-query need is real where the lock context is computed. Satisfied by live profiles columns. SHARED admin-first entity: app_role/plan_label/status are protected — reconcile, never reshape.

rows.screenRequirement: 프로모션 없음 / 가격 조회 실패 / 플랜 정보 없음 시 폴백 문구
rows.docSource: description.md L43 (프로모션 없음/가격 조회 실패 시 기본 가격 문구로 대체); functional-spec.md L29 (플랜 정보 없음)
rows.rationale: Empty-result / fetch-error fallbacks are client-side UI states (noPlans alert, error Result). No DB source needed; the absence of rows in subscription_plans drives the fallback. Satisfied.

rows.screenRequirement: paywall 기능별 제한 문구 / upsell 카피를 운영 데이터로 관리하는 구조
rows.docSource: screen-data-summary.md L38 (paywall 문구/권한 설명 = LABEL '스키마 보강 필요'; 확정 계약: 운영 데이터로 관리하는 구조는 없다; 메모: 현재는 plan catalog와 앱 문구를 조합한다)
rows.rationale: CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL applied: the row is LABELED '스키마 보강 필요' but its 확정 계약 column states there IS NO operational structure and the 메모 confirms current behavior = plan catalog + app copy combined. description.md states NO concrete query/validation/render need for operationally-managed upsell copy (Regions 1/4/5 are static app strings). Therefore not a real stable-query need and not currently jsonb-covered by any live column. This is deferred operational/CMS scope → UNRESOLVED / escalate; do not invent a copy/upsell table. Frozen-island unaffected.
